cd /workspace && cat > tmp/widest.py <<'PY'
import heapq,time
def widest_plan(H,participants,roots):
    P=sorted(participants);idx={v:i for i,v in enumerate(P)};k=len(P)
    cap=[{} for _ in range(k)]
    for a,b,d in H.edges(data=True):
        c=d.get('capacity',0)
        if c>0:cap[idx[a]][idx[b]]=cap[idx[a]].get(idx[b],0)+c
    records=[];D=sum(roots.values())
    for rv in P:
        r=idx[rv];rem=roots[rv]
        while rem>0:
            # max-min Dijkstra from r
            val=[-1]*k;par=[-1]*k;val[r]=10**100;pq=[(-val[r],r)]
            while pq:
                nv,u=heapq.heappop(pq);nv=-nv
                if nv!=val[u]:continue
                for v,c in cap[u].items():
                    z=c if c<nv else nv
                    if z>val[v]:
                        val[v]=z;par[v]=u;heapq.heappush(pq,(-z,v))
            if any(val[i]<0 for i in range(k)):return None,None
            bn=min(val)
            if bn<=0:return None,None
            w=min(rem,bn)
            es=[]
            for v in range(k):
                if v==r:continue
                u=par[v]
                if u<0:return None,None
                es.append((u,v))
                c=cap[u][v]-w
                if c<0:return None,None
                if c==0:del cap[u][v]
                else:cap[u][v]=c
            records.append((r,w,es));rem-=w
    return records,cap
